title: Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron remained the core mainstream DRAM suppliers
canonical_summary: Current industry observations continued to place Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron at the center of mainstream DRAM supply while the group operated near capacity and shifted wafer allocation toward HBM.
known_event_summary: August 27-September 7, 2026 mainstream DRAM structure: Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron dominated the market, operated at capacity and tilted wafer capacity toward HBM.

facts.proposition: The three major memory manufacturers are operating at capacity.
The mainstream DRAM market is dominated by Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron Technology.
Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, and Micron are operating at capacity.
SK Hynix, Micron, and Samsung have tilted wafer capacity toward high-bandwidth memory (HBM).
